notes.Tyrese Haliburton: He had 23 points and 12 assists in 34 minutes in his first game back from a torn Achilles, and Indiana hosts Dallas tonight with TJ McConnell out.
notes.Trae Young: He played 38 minutes in his Washington debut with 20 points and 13 assists, and AJ Dybantsa is out again tonight against Toronto.
notes.Anthony Davis: He had 34 points and 12 rebounds in 34 minutes in the opener with a usage rate around 36%, and he is playing tonight against Toronto.
notes.Kyshawn George: He starts again with AJ Dybantsa out, after taking 14 shots in the opener with the second-highest usage on the team.
notes.Bilal Coulibaly: He starts again with AJ Dybantsa out, after playing 29 minutes in the opener.
notes.Naz Reid: He starts at power forward for Charlotte with Kon Knueppel, Coby White and Grant Williams out, after a 20-point, 11-rebound, seven-assist debut on 19 shots.
notes.Dennis Schroder: He starts at point guard again with Coby White out, after playing about 35 minutes in the opener.
notes.Moussa Diabaté: He played 34 minutes in the opener and looks like Charlotte’s main center.
notes.Grayson Allen: He played 29 minutes off the bench in the opener and should have the same role tonight with Kon Knueppel and Coby White out.
notes.Tristan da Silva: Anthony Black is out again, and da Silva played 28 minutes off the bench in the opener while no other Orlando reserve reached 15.
notes.Paolo Banchero: He played 41 minutes in the opener and took 16 free throws on the way to 35 points and 10 assists.
notes.Obi Toppin: He scored 20 points in 25 minutes off the bench in the opener, and Indiana did not play Jay Huff.
notes.Kyrie Irving: He played only 24 minutes in a blowout loss in the opener, and tonight is the first game of a back-to-back, so he may sit Saturday.
notes.PJ Washington: He played 31 minutes in the opener and doubled as Dallas’s backup center.
notes.Naji Marshall: He played 29 minutes off the bench in the opener.
notes.Ausar Thompson: He played 33 minutes in the opener as a secondary ball-handler, and Detroit hosts Miami in the highest total on the early slate.
notes.Karl-Anthony Towns: He played only 24 minutes in the opener because of early foul trouble.
notes.Aaron Wiggins: He played 32 minutes in the opener because of foul trouble and rest for teammates, and mid-20s is the normal expectation.
notes.Kawhi Leonard: He barely played in the preseason, and Toronto sent him back in during a blowout to build up his minutes.
notes.Jalen Duren: He played 28 minutes in the opener against Boston and dominated inside.
